rule: Recordings: session T1 -> train; session T2, first recording of a letter (start-time order) -> cal; T2, later recordings -> test. Local id = P<n>/T<m>/<stem>. Payload = file size in bytes. Sentences: the v0.1 composed-sentence set (cal / test). Local id = <participant>-<split>-<nn>. Payload = truth text | SHA-256 of the press ids.

units.sentence: one composed sentence (v0.1 recipe: per character one real day-2 press of that character)
